entries.name: control-panel
entries.summary: Only Captain-linked HR/access, fleet, dispatch/custody/proof/support/rescue and WLT finance operator functions are in scope.

entries.name: app-client
entries.summary: Readback only for Captain-caused delivery/tracking/order state; client-owned product flows stay out.

entries.name: app-partner
entries.summary: Only partner-fleet and store↔Captain custody/handoff consequences are Captain dependencies; app-partner planning artifacts themselves are excluded.

entries.name: app-captain
entries.summary: Primary surface: access/readiness, fleet/availability, dispatch/execution, tracking/PoD/support and WLT-backed finance.

entries.name: app-field
entries.summary: Explicitly assessed to prevent scope bleed.
entries.exclusionReason: Store↔Captain custody excludes app-field, and field commission/product lifecycle is independent of Captain implementation even when a generic finance component is shared.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if a Captain-proven fix changes a shared contract/component/state actually consumed by app-field; then verify that affected shared consumer without importing field-only product work.

entries.name: administration
entries.summary: Captain role/surface/access approvals only.

entries.name: analytics
entries.summary: No current Captain Product Truth requires analytics as a writer or mandatory readback.
entries.exclusionReason: Captain decisions are owned by readiness/dispatch/operations/finance paths, not generic analytics.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if current Product Truth or source makes Captain authorization/state depend on analytics.

entries.name: catalogs
entries.summary: Catalog state is not part of Captain access, assignment, custody, support or finance truth.
entries.exclusionReason: No direct Captain dependency is established.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if a current Captain contract makes execution/eligibility depend on a catalog mutation/readback.

entries.name: dashboard
entries.summary: Generic dashboard is not a canonical Captain writer/readback.
entries.exclusionReason: Required operator actions are in dedicated HR/operations/support/finance paths.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen if dashboard becomes a mandatory canonical Captain readback in Product Truth.

entries.name: hr
entries.summary: Captain lifecycle/readiness and Captain fleet membership views only.

entries.name: login
entries.summary: Generic operator login does not own Captain state.
entries.exclusionReason: app-captain uses its own Identity role/surface session path; control-panel login is generic operator infrastructure.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only for a proven Captain-specific operator-auth dependency beyond generic authentication.

entries.name: marketing
entries.summary: Marketing does not own Captain operational or financial truth.
entries.exclusionReason: No applicable Captain Product Truth requires this section.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if a current Captain rule is explicitly governed by a marketing capability.

entries.name: operations
entries.summary: Captain dispatch, custody/proof, exceptions and rescue only.

entries.name: partners
entries.summary: Redacted partner-fleet operator readback for the same DSH membership truth.

entries.name: platform
entries.summary: Only service-area/capacity configuration proven to gate Captain dispatch eligibility.

entries.name: support
entries.summary: Assigned-order Captain support queue and operator support readback only.

entries.name: finance
entries.summary: WLT finance controls/readback directly affecting Captain wallet/COD/commission/payout lifecycle.

entries.name: captain-product-truth
entries.summary: Current authority and applicable Captain Product Truth bound the implementation.

entries.name: architecture-evidence
entries.summary: ArchPulse drawio is a discovery aid only; exact source/contracts remain implementation truth.

entries.name: app-captain-runtime
entries.summary: Session/device/readiness/push/mobile transport/location/PoD require Captain runtime evidence; shared LAN gateway infrastructure is included only as a current transport dependency.

entries.name: captain-shared-frontend

entries.name: captain-dsh-wlt-contracts
entries.summary: Captain dispatch/fleet/handoff/support/finance operations require contract/source/client parity.

entries.name: captain-backend-domain
entries.summary: Identity/Workforce, DSH and WLT-backed routes must enforce trusted actor scope and legal state transitions.
